'''2020 TMW Final Four Mike Kessling LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Kessling]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Final Four).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mike Kessling]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|They Have No Idea We're Coming / Until We Win, Or The Chances Are Spent|V9-L-theyhavenoideawerecoming.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open TRM Kessling LS 2020 TMW.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Final Four
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-texas-mini-worlds/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20201027000438/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-texas-mini-worlds/ Internet Archive]
